criteria.text: Diagnosis of osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, or ankylosing spondylitis.
Trial of a combination of a generic NSAID and a generic PPI for one month, with treatment failure of the two separate medications.
Letter of medical necessity submitted detailing treatment failure of the two separate medications.

notes: Partial encoding of Alaska Medicaid Vimovo (naproxen/esomeprazole magnesium). Delayed-release tablets: 375mg-20mg and 500mg-20mg. Supporting trial documentation and letter contents require manual review.

FDA indication context: relief of signs and symptoms of osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, and ankylosing spondylitis and to decrease the risk of developing gastric ulcers in patients at risk of NSAID-associated gastric ulcers. Gastric-ulcer risk reduction accompanies the arthritis indication; it is not a standalone approval indication.

FDA limitations (notes only): not recommended for initial treatment of acute pain because naproxen absorption is delayed compared with other naproxen-containing products. Controlled studies do not extend beyond 6 months.
Authorization (notes only): coverage may be approved for up to 6 months.
Dispensing (notes only): 30-day supply; quantity limit 2 doses/day.
